# Paper-trading qualification checklist (paper-qualification.yml). One group per area; every name must run and pass on SQLite and
# PostgreSQL 16. These are existing tests: this file says which of them make up the qualification, it adds no new assertion.
# PostgreSQL-only additions (race of two independent connections on one signal) are in postgres-only.txt and run there too.

# order lifecycle
test_the_real_execution_engine_trades_against_it_and_an_outage_leaves_an_unknown_order_not_a_guess
test_create_bot_over_http_then_see_an_order_and_a_protected_position
test_a_probe_buy_goes_through_risk_and_execution_and_fills_at_the_next_open_not_the_close_it_saw
# position lifecycle, entry and exit
test_enter_protected_then_exit_on_stop_then_restart_recovers_an_open_position
test_an_entry_that_the_volume_cap_splits_over_several_bars_is_applied_to_the_position_as_it_fills
test_a_strategy_exit_is_filled_at_the_next_open_and_labelled
test_sell_entry_with_no_position_is_blocked_and_sends_nothing
# stop-loss, take-profit and time stop
test_stop_closes_the_position
test_when_one_bar_could_hit_both_the_stop_comes_first
test_a_gap_through_the_stop_fills_at_the_quoted_bid_not_at_the_stop_price
test_the_stop_is_held_for_two_cycles_loudly_and_entries_are_blocked
test_a_triggered_take_profit_in_a_wide_spread_waits_is_not_reported_closed_and_is_audited_without_an_incident
test_the_configured_limit_reaches_the_monitor_and_closes_an_aged_position
# partial exits
test_a_partial_exit_records_reason_quantities_order_and_reconciliation_status
test_the_remainder_fills_in_stages_and_a_replayed_report_changes_nothing
test_an_inconsistent_filled_report_is_not_trusted_and_never_closes_the_position
test_a_cancelled_remainder_returns_to_open_and_the_next_exit_sells_only_what_is_left
# spread and slippage
test_an_adverse_ask_keeps_the_loss_at_the_stop_within_the_approved_risk
test_range_slippage_alone_makes_a_wild_bar_cost_more_by_exactly_the_configured_amount
test_through_any_spread_up_to_the_suspect_limit_and_with_no_tolerance_the_stop_is_sent_at_once
# execution delays and rejected orders
test_an_order_cannot_fill_before_the_latency_has_passed_and_fills_at_the_later_price
test_9a_exchange_timeouts_block_new_orders_then_escalate_to_an_incident
test_a_malformed_quote_never_produces_an_order_a_guessed_price_or_a_closed_position
# duplicate-order prevention
test_a_second_exit_request_while_one_is_pending_is_refused_and_a_replay_is_a_duplicate
test_a_lost_order_response_is_reconciled_from_the_exchange_and_never_sold_twice
# risk-limit enforcement
test_loss_at_the_stop_and_notional_never_exceed_what_was_approved
test_the_last_gate_stops_an_oversized_quantity_even_if_sizing_misbehaves
test_drawdown_from_an_unrealised_loss_blocks_a_new_entry_through_the_running_application
test_the_final_gate
# persistence
test_position_survives_an_application_restart_and_is_closed_by_its_stop
test_a_pending_partial_exit_survives_a_restart_and_is_finished_from_the_exchange_report
# crash recovery
test_1_crash_before_intent_commit
test_4_crash_after_exchange_accepts_before_local_ack
test_6_crash_after_fill_received_before_local_transaction_commits
test_9b_database_outage_fails_closed_and_sends_nothing
test_stop_and_take_profit_survive_sigkill_and_a_fresh_engine_enforces_them
# reconciliation
test_8_crash_during_reconciliation
test_a_reducing_position_whose_exit_outcome_is_unknown_is_quarantined_for_reconciliation
test_fill_for_a_vanished_position_opens_a_critical_incident_and_recover_completes
